appearance_facts.fact: A blue line with circular markers descends from left to right across the plot.
A light purple filled region spans the full width behind the line.
The first data point sits near the top of the visible series, around y-axis 1.3.
The final data point is the lowest on the series, near y-axis 2.4.
A small local rise/plateau appears around 2003-2004 before the decline resumes.

printed_facts.fact: Title reads: 'Year vs. Number of doctors per 1,000 inhabitants'.
Y-axis is labeled 'Count' with tick values 0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5 increasing downward.
Series value at 2000.0 is approximately 1.3 doctors per 1,000 inhabitants.
Series value at 2017.5 is approximately 2.4 doctors per 1,000 inhabitants.
Series value at 2010.0 is approximately 2.0 doctors per 1,000 inhabitants.
